About the Thursday Night Social Ride group ride

Austin's big weekly cruise, with 150 to 350 riders most Thursdays. Easy pace, rotating ride leader, and a stop or two along the way. Meets at Chicano Park on the east side. Ride details post to Instagram each week.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
